pages.title: Chapter 1: Craft Stone Tools
pages.text: §7[Start Your Adventure]$(br2)In Forgeborne Odyssey, your first tools will be made from cobblestone. Surface cobblestone is the most basic resource, found everywhere on the surface.$(br)Look for surface cobblestone and use it to craft hammers and chisels to begin your forging journey.
§bCobblestone Hammer§r - Basic forging tool. Strike metal billets on the anvil.
§bHandle Hammer§r - More efficient forging tool. More durable with a wooden handle.
§bStone Chisel§r - For fine carving. Final metal products need chisel carving to complete.

pages.title: Flint Tools
pages.text: Besides cobblestone tools, you can craft sharper tools from flint:$(br)$(li)Flint Knife - Basic weapon$(br)$(li)Flint Shovel - Digging tool$(br)$(li)Flint Sickle - Crop harvesting

pages.title: Tip
pages.text: §aTip: Craft hammer and chisel first!$(br2)Hammers are the core forging tool, and chisels are the key to carving final products. Craft enough hammers and chisels before looking for metals.
